tagline: In late September 2026, Genie Agents will be restricted to using only the data sources explicitly attached under the agent's Sources.
what_it_does: In late September 2026, Genie Agents will be restricted to using only the data sources explicitly attached under the agent's Sources. Currently, a Genie Agent can go beyond its attached data sources if tables or Unity Catalog functions are referenced in its instructions. Create, share, and manage a Genie Agent, the natural language chat interface that business users use to ask questions of their data in Databricks.
why_it_matters: Before sharing the agent with users, Databricks recommends adding example SQL queries, instructions, and knowledge store configurations to improve response accuracy.
